headline: 1 killed in warehouse explosion in Old Dhaka's Bangshal
summary: A motorcycle parts warehouse blast, suspected to be caused by a gas leak, left one businessman dead and another seriously burned.
details: A businessman named Delwar Hossain, 35, was killed after an explosion and fire broke out in a motorcycle parts warehouse in Mukim Bazar, Bangshal, Old Dhaka.

The incident occurred around 4:30 AM on Friday. Delwar and his cousin, Nazmul Hossain, 33, descended from the third floor of the building where Delwar lived with his family after noticing smoke coming from the ground floor warehouse.
Immediately upon reaching the ground floor, a massive explosion occurred, causing a wall to collapse and trapping Delwar under the debris. Nazmul was seriously burned in the blast.
According to Bangshal Police Station OC AKM Mahfuzul Haque, the explosion is suspected to be caused by gas accumulating from a pipeline leak, which ignited when the door was opened.

Two units of the Fire Service and Civil Defence brought the fire under control after approximately two hours of effort. Both victims were rushed to Dhaka Medical College Hospital, where Delwar was declared dead.
Delwar Hossain was an importer of motorcycle parts. His body has been kept in the hospital morgue for an autopsy.

headline_marked: Israel warns US: [[Iran planning to assassinate Trump]]
headline: Israel warns US: Iran planning to assassinate Trump
summary: Israel has alerted the United States about a potential plot by Iran to target Donald Trump, amid escalating regional tensions.
details: Israel has informed the United States that Iran is allegedly planning an assassination attempt against Donald Trump.
This warning comes at a time of heightened volatility in the Middle East, following several high-profile strikes and diplomatic frictions.
The U.S. government is reportedly monitoring the situation closely as intelligence agencies assess the validity and scale of the threat.
Meanwhile, the U.S. has stated that discussions are ongoing following severe attacks in Iran, aiming to manage the escalation between the two powers.
